# kernscope-bench: the roofline peak measurement CLI (wave-4 todo 22).
#
# Measures the gfx1101 roofline peaks on this machine (RX 7800 XT) through the
# kernscope::bench harness (validated methodology: time-based warmup/rep, L2
# flush, event timing, adaptive trials — docs/research/
# autotuner-research-brief.md §6) and writes libs/db JSONL records with
# provenance (device name, gcnArchName, rocm-smi clocks as-measured, tool
# version, measured=true). The peaks.hsaco module is generated by
# libs/bench (KERNSCOPE_BENCH_HSACO CACHE var); without hipcc the binary still
# builds but errors at runtime with a clear message.

add_executable(kernscope-bench main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(kernscope-bench PRIVATE
  kernscope::bench
  kernscope::db
  kernscope::gpuruntime
  kernscope::arch
)
set_target_properties(kernscope-bench PROPERTIES
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)

if(KERNSCOPE_BENCH_HSACO)
  target_compile_definitions(kernscope-bench PRIVATE
    KERNSCOPE_BENCH_HSACO="${KERNSCOPE_BENCH_HSACO}")
  add_dependencies(kernscope-bench kernscope_bench_hsaco)
else()
  target_compile_definitions(kernscope-bench PRIVATE KERNSCOPE_BENCH_HSACO="")
  message(STATUS "bench CLI: peaks.hsaco unavailable (no hipcc at configure "
                 "time); kernscope-bench will error at runtime")
endif()

# --- version smoke test (runs anywhere -> no-gpu) ---------------------------
add_test(NAME bench-version COMMAND kernscope-bench --version)
set_tests_properties(bench-version PROPERTIES LABELS "no-gpu")
